Damaged. Gives the genealogy and the duration of the reigns of the Eastern Chalukya kings down to the king. Registers the grant of the village Pulivaru in the Veṅgi-deśa-viṣaya, by the king, to Indaparāja, the grandson of Indaparāja of the Mahārāja-vaṃśa, who was the 'lord of the city of Maṇyakhēṭa'.

Registers the grant, by the king, of the village Peṇukaparru in the Karma-rāṣṭra to Śrī Bhra-Drōṇaśarmman, who was a resident of Vaṅgīparru, who was proficient in the four Vedas and all the Śāstras, and who was the son of Dēvaśarmman who had performed the Sarvakratu-sacrifice, and the grandson of Guṇja-Dēvaśarmman, of the Kauṇḍinya-gōtra, Taittirīya-śākhā and the Āpastamba-sūtra.

Some plates are missing in the middle. Registers the royal grant of Ukkal, reuniting the taxes on shares of land and house-sites, in ratification of the kai-dai given to the residents of Avanindaram-chaturvedi-mangalam, which was founded after the king by Alagiyadar alias Mahabali-Vapara-yar, at Tirundrayanapuram in Vadagarai Rajaraja-valanadu.

The inscription is engraved on the two sides of a curved copper scimitar with a cup-like depression at the head. Records the gift of a land and a pair of golden eyes to the god Survel-Kandan (Subrahmanya) at Mayiladi, by commander (Dalavay) called Raghu-natha-Sethupati.

cells.location: Siruvayal, Ramnad district † — Tamil Nadu

cells.remarks: Gift of land made tax-free by the same chief for providing for a flower-garden to the temple, which was in charge of a member of the Pa ālveṇaiy-i-urunaḍam on the north side of the temple.

cells.location: Vaḍḍakkampatti, Sivagaṅga taluk, Rāmnād district — Tamil Nadu

cells.location: Siruvayal, Ramnad district † — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On the same wall
cells.remarks: Records the gift of the taxes due from Muḍaliyar Karakaivaṇ-Panditar on a certain land at Alaigaluppāru by the same chief for special worship in the temple on the day of Uttarāyan which was his star of birth. Mentions the measuring rod called Sundara-Pāṇḍya-kōl.

cells.location: Vaḍḍakkampatti, Sivagaṅga taluk, Rāmnād district — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On the same wall
cells.remarks: A grant of land as ‘tax-free karaiyma’ by Naṭṭāvar of the assembly of Piḷḷaiyār-Nāyaṇār set up in the temple by a certain Vepuḍaiyau of Arhaṭṭuk-kūrram in Paṇḍikulapati-valanādu, a subdivision in Sōla-maṇḍalam.

cells.location: Vaḍḍakkampatti, Sivagaṅga taluk, Rāmnād district
cells.place: On the same wall
cells.remarks: Records a gift of land to the temple for worship on the days of the asterism Bharani which was the natal star of the donor Nahavach-chakrava ṭi, after purchasing it from the assembly of Ko amaṅgalam in Tirattiyūr-Mu am, the tenantry of which was given to a certain Minna-ttena <div>ayaṇ alias Ayan Sōlan.

cells.location: Siruvayal, Ramnad district † — Tamil Nadu

cells.location: Siruvayal, Ramnad district † — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On the same wall

cells.location: Siruvayal, Ramnad district † — Tamil Nadu

cells.location: Siruvayal, Ramnad district † — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On the west wall of the same maṇḍapa.
cells.remarks: Records the setting up of the images of Dēvī-nāyaṇār and Piḷi-Na ṭalvār in the shrine of Ilaiya-Nāyaṇār referred to in No. 51 above, by the dharmakartas of the temple.

cells.location: Siruvayal, Ramnad district † — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On the same wall
cells.remarks: Records the grant of the taxes on the lands in Virānippurru to the temple of Muṇummūliśōla-Īśvaramuḍaiya-Nāyaṇār at Ki[ḷai]ttiruttiyūr-Mu am, a subdivision of Kēralāṇtaka-vaḻanādu, by Dalavāy Kana-kappa-Nāyakkar, the agent of the king.

cells.location: Siruvayal, Ramnad district † — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On the south wall of the same maṇḍapa.
cells.remarks: Registers a similar grant of the taxes on some plots of land in Anniyur to the temple by Sirainīkkuḍaiyān Tirukkaṇṇapurammuḍaiyān Malava-chakravartil; the land being made over to a certain Alagiya-Sōkaṇar.

cells.location: Siruvayal, Ramnad district † — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On the same wall
cells.remarks: Damaged. Records a gift of land by purchase by a certain Adaikkalaṅgattar to an individual reciting the tirup-pāttu (Dēvāram) in the temple for the maintenance of a matha.

cells.location: Vaḍḍakkampatti, Sivagaṅga taluk, Rāmnād district — Tamil Nadu

cells.remarks: Incomplete. Seems to record a sale of land by a number of residents of Pagavur and other villages in Mēḻāi-Tiruttiyur-Mu am to the temple.

cells.location: Vaḍḍakkampatti, Sivagaṅga taluk, Rāmnād district — Tamil Nadu

cells.remarks: Records the gift of certain lands as tax-free (iraiyili) ka rāṇmai for the maintenance of a flower-garden for the temple by Malavaṇ-chakravatti.

cells.remarks: Registers an agreement by the tanattar of the temple to measure out a muli of rice daily for offerings to the image of Rishabhadeva for the money received by them from a certain resident of the village.

cells.location: Siruvayal, Ramnad district † — Tamil Nadu

cells.location: Siruvayal, Ramnad district † — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On the same wall
cells.remarks: Records another gift of land by puōhase by the same chief for a service in the temple of Tirumatṭṇkkaraiya[pṇda]-Nayaṇar in Kērnajśinga-vajanaṇa. cells.location: Siruvayal, Ramnad district † — Tamil Nadu

cells.location: Siruvayal, Ramnad district † — Tamil Nadu

cells.location: Siruvayal, Ramnad district † — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On the west and south walls of the same shrine.

cells.location: Siruvayal, Ramnad district † — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On the south wall of the same shrine.
cells.remarks: The inscription opens with the eulogy of [Ma]ṛavarman alias Tribhuvanachakravartin Kulōttunga-Chōḷadeva "who having been pleased to take the two Kongus, Ilam and Karuvūr, was pleased to perform the anointment of victors at the maṇḍapa at Paḻaiyāṛu and was pleased to begin afresh." Records the remission of taxes due on some lands belonging to the temple by Chakravatti Veṇ-muḍi-aḍaiyār-Nāḷvan for offerings and worship to the god in the Malavāśiṅga-sandhi for the merit of his [s]iyan.

cells.location: Siruvayal, Ramnad district † — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On the same wall
cells.remarks: Records certain changes made by Kayadan Alagukadun-Perumal alias Gangaiyan the standard land measure and in the rate of taxes due on the lands owing to some securities of the old system under which people were suffering.

cells.location: Vaḍḍakkampatti, Sivagaṅga taluk, Rāmnād district
cells.place: On the same wall
cells.remarks: Much damaged. Records the remission of taxes on some lands belonging to a certain Viḷupparaiyāri in favour of the temple by the chief mentioned in No. 72 above.

cells.location: Siruvayal, Ramnad district † — Tamil Nadu

cells.location: Siruvayal, Ramnad district † — Tamil Nadu

cells.location: Vaḍḍakkampatti, Sivagaṅga taluk, Rāmnād district
cells.place: On the same wall
cells.remarks: Registers a gift of land for the maintenance of a matha called Tiruvun-nukaraiṇ-tirunmadam in the temple, jointly by the chiefs Malavaṇmaṇikkam alias Malavaṇ-chakrava tti and Aḍaiyāru-Naidalvar and of another piece of land by another peoson.

cells.location: Vaḍḍakkampatti, Sivagaṅga taluk, Rāmnād district

cells.location: Siruvayal, Ramnad district † — Tamil Nadu

cells.location: Siruvayal, Ramnad district † — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On the north wall of the same mandapa.
cells.remarks: Records the grant, by Kaṇḍan Udaiyadēvar alias Gaṅgēyan of Niyamam in Teṉ-Paṇḍināḍu, of the taxes due on some lands bought from the assembly of Periohōiyūr by a certain Kaṇḍan Udaiyadēvar alias Gaṅgēyan, for offerings to Tirumalai-k-kāval-Nāyaṉār.

cells.location: Siruvayal, Ramnad district † — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On the same wall

cells.location: Vaḍḍakkampatti, Sivagaṅga taluk, Rāmnād district
cells.place: On the same wall

cells.location: Vaḍḍakkampatti, Sivagaṅga taluk, Rāmnād district
cells.place: On the same wall

cells.location: Vaḍḍakkampatti, Sivagaṅga taluk, Rāmnād district
cells.place: On the same wall

cells.location: Siruvayal, Ramnad district † — Tamil Nadu

cells.location: Siruvayal, Ramnad district † — Tamil Nadu

cells.location: Siruvayal, Ramnad district † — Tamil Nadu

cells.location: Siruvayal, Ramnad district † — Tamil Nadu

cells.location: Siruvayal, Ramnad district † — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On the south wall of the same shrine.

cells.location: Pīraṉmalai, Tirupputtūr taluk, Rāmnād district †
cells.place: On the west wall of the kitchen (inside), in the same temple.
cells.remarks: Begins with the introduction pūmaruviya tirumādhu, etc. Records the royal order made at the request of Mālavarāyar, making a tax-free gift of the village of Nāḍamaṅgalam in Vikramārama-vaḷanāḍu, for the maintenance of a matha called Śrī Pārvati-maḍam built at Tirukkoḍuṅguṇṛam in Puṟamalai-nāḍu by a certain Jñānaśiva-Rāvalar the disciple of Śrī-Dēśikēndra of the Gōjāvamśa and the Lakṣaḍhyāyi-santāna in the Āryāvarta country.

cells.location: Pīraṉmalai, Tirupputtūr taluk, Rāmnād district †
cells.place: On the same wall
cells.remarks: Built in by ares about the beginning. Records the state of the royal order or the royal order communicated to the donee.

cells.location: Pīraṇamalai, Tirupputtūr taluk, Rāmnād district †
cells.place: On the same wall
cells.remarks: Begins with the introduction pūmaruviya, etc. Built in similarly and damaged. Records the actual effect given to the royal order mentioned above, by the king's officers who formally handed over the tirumaṅgam (order) of prince (Piḷḷaiyār) Aḷagapperumāḷ and the king (Perumāḷ) together with the Tiruvaykkelvi and the Uivari to the donee.

cells.location: Pīraṉmalai, Tirupputtūr taluk, Rāmnād district † — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On the south wall of the same kitchen.
cells.date: Śaka 1422, Raudri, Uttarāyaṇam, Vasantartu, Pōshya śu. aṣṭami, Sunday, Rēvati, Makara-sam[krānti].
cells.remarks: Registers a gift of the village of Vēṅgaikkuḷam alias Ipparruppuram in the same place to two brāhmaṇas of Puṟamalai-nāḍu, by Dēppa-nāyakkār, for the merit of Ayyan Tipparar-Ayyar.

cells.location: Pīraṉmalai, Tirupputtūr taluk, Rāmnād district †
cells.place: On the same wall
cells.date: Śaka 1422, [Raudri], Uttarāyaṇam, Mēsha, Monday, ēkādaśi, Makha.
cells.remarks: A similar gift of the village Kīḷaikkuḷalūr by the same person, as a maḍappuram, to Paṇḍināḍu-Mudaliyār of the Bhikṣāmaṭha-santāna alias Lakṣaḍhyāyi-santāna and the Gōḷaki-maṭha, who was the manager of the temple and the maḍam at Tirukkoḍuṅguṇṛam alias Dakshiṇa-Kailāsam. Records the grant of the hereditary right of Maḍappat-yam (management) over the temple to two individuals.

cells.location: Pīraṉmalai, Tirupputtūr taluk, Rāmnād district † — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On the east wall of the Viśvanātha shrine in the same temple.

cells.location: Pīraṉmalai, Tirupputtūr taluk, Rāmnād district † — Tamil Nadu
cells.remarks: Damaged. Records a gift of land by a certain Narasaṇṇan, son of Vaṇṇi [ga]r Nāyakkar, for offerings to certain images including those of Chandēśvara and Ṛishabha-dēva which he had set up in the temple.

cells.location: Pīraṉmalai, Tirupputtūr taluk, Rāmnād district † — Tamil Nadu
cells.date: 17th year, Mitbuna, bn. suptami, Wednesday, Uttiratṇadi.
cells.remarks: Records a gift of 50 oows for burning 20 lamps daily from twilight to midnight (ardbayama) at the southern entrance of the Tirunāvukkaraśu-tirumaṇdapam on the west side of the temple, by a native of Kurundagai-naḍu.

cells.location: Pīraṉmalai, Tirupputtūr taluk, Rāmnād district †
cells.date: Śaka 14[61], Vikari Dakshināyanu, Grishmaritu, Karkaṭaka, bn. ekadaśi, Friday, Rōhini.
cells.remarks: Seriously damaged. Seems to record a gift to the temple by Iḷamappa-Nāyakkar-Ayyan, son of Baurava Na[ya]kkar, for the merit of the king.

cells.location: Pīraṉmalai, Tirupputtūr taluk, Rāmnād district †
cells.remarks: Records that Bhuvanōkavīra, called also Rājanārāyaṇa, built this high and spacious gōpura in the temple of Chandrādri (Śiva) called Koḍuṅgūr in the Tamil portion.

cells.location: Pīraṉmalai, Tirupputtūr taluk, Rāmnād district †
cells.remarks: Records the gift of the taxes from the surrounding (?) villages, to the temple, for the pulugusattu (oivet coating) to the images of the god and the goddess.

cells.location: Pīraṉmalai, Tirupputtūr taluk, Rāmnād district †
cells.remarks: Damaged. Mentions the same transaction and records the entry made of it in the register of tax-free lands.

cells.location: Pīraṉmalai, Tirupputtūr taluk, Rāmnād district †
cells.date: Śaka 1463, Manmatha (wrong), Arpaśi 20, navami, Punarpūsam, bn. Wednesday, Amritayōga.
cells.remarks: Damaged. Seems to record the confirmation of the kapi-yāchi right over some dēvadāna lands with all their income, exclusive of the land-grants already made to other donees, by Kaśavana-Nāyakkar-Ellappa-Nāyakkar, the agent of Abhyudayarāya-Nāyakkar.

cells.location: Pīraṉmalai, Tirupputtūr taluk, Rāmnād district † — Tamil Nadu
cells.remarks: Records the gift of the village Aṛuvūr alias Kulaśēkhara-pāḷaiyam in Koṇāḍu-nāḍu, excluding other previ-ous grants, to the temple of Iḷamappa-Nāyakkar for the merit of the king, by the king's agent.

cells.location: Pīraṉmalai, Tirupputtūr taluk, Rāmnād district †
cells.remarks: Records a sarvamānya gift by the temple, of a dēvadāna, the tirukkuikāvam (honour), together with the reunion of alvari tax granted to a certain Pakkamu-ḍaiyār Āvuḍaiyār alias Peiyāḍaiyār of Aṛuviyūr, by the officer mentioned above.

cells.location: Pīraṉmalai, Tirupputtūr taluk, Rāmnād district † — Tamil Nadu
cells.date: Śaka 1ō10, Sarvadhari, [Uttarayana, Ani 1] 6, Viśakha, Sunday, prathama.
cells.remarks: Records a gift by yurchase of two villages in Neduvayal-śirmai as a dōvadana to the temple by a certain Kaliyangattu-Meyyar alias Toṭṭippil]ai of Sirudai-ūr in Sola-Pandya-valanaḍu. Gives the names of the king's predecessors from Immaṇi Naraśingaraya and a number of birudas assumed by the king, among which occur those of Aobyutaraya mentioned in No. 222 above.

cells.location: Pīraṉmalai, Tirupputtūr taluk, Rāmnād district † — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On the east side of the gōpura in front of the same temple.
cells.remarks: Registers a sale of land at Sōjamādēvi belonging to the temple for 40 panam to a certain Tiruvamudaiya-mudaliyār of Mangalam in Togaai-maņdalam who endowed it for the midday service of the god Mangaināyaka-svāmi.

cells.location: Pīraṉmalai, Tirupputtūr taluk, Rāmnād district † — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: In the same place
cells.remarks: Much damaged. Seems to record a gift of land to the temple by a certain Sundaran Šeliyadaraiyan of Venkatṭu-kkōṭtam for burning two twilight lamps on the west side of the Buvanekavi[raṇ]....[va]ša.

cells.location: Pīraṉmalai, Tirupputtūr taluk, Rāmnād district † — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On the west side of the same gōpura.
cells.remarks: Damaged. Registers a sale of temple land similar to that mentioned in No. 226 above, for 30 paṇam to a certain individual of Palayanūr in Tondā-mandalam for special worship on festival days (viļapūšai) in the temple.

cells.location: Pīraṉmalai, Tirupputtūr taluk, Rāmnād district † — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: In the same place
cells.remarks: Records a gift of 200 paṇam by a certain Ādi-Nāyaka of Teḷingakulakālapuram in Koṇḍu vias Kulaśēkhara-iḷangaikonda-valanāḍu to the temple for burning two lamps at the base-built by himself near the Bhuvanēkaviran-tirumaṇṭapam.

cells.location: Pīraṉmalai, Tirupputtūr taluk, Rāmnād district † — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On the south wall (inside) of the ardhamāṇḍapa of the goddess' shrine in the Ugraēriśvara temple in the same place.
cells.remarks: Right end obstructed by images. Registers a tax-free gift as dēvadana of the village of Pullūgri alias Šivallavanalūr in Tenka[lavaļi-nađu, to the temple, by the king, for the daily offerings and worship of the image of Aluđaiya-Nachohiyār Nallamaṅgaiyār at the request of Kalingarāyar. Mentions the measuring rod Sundara-Pāṇdyan-kol.

cells.location: Pīraṉmalai, Tirupputtūr taluk, Rāmnād district † — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On the west wall of the Subrahmanya shrine in the same temple.
cells.remarks: Gift of the village Ādiyanūr, as a tax-free dēvadane, to the teruple for providing unguents to the image of the god by a certain Aļagiyān Rajanarayanadēvar.

cells.location: Pīraṉmalai, Tirupputtūr taluk, Rāmnād district †
cells.place: On the same wall
cells.remarks: Gift of a tax-free land by a certain lady for offerings and worship to the image of Nēchchiyār Bhōgamati-Pbrumulaiyal who had set up in the temple.

cells.location: Pīraṇamalai, Tirupputtūr taluk, Rāmnād district † — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On the same wall
cells.date: [6]th year, Ka[rka]-ṭaka, ba. Wednesday, ashṭami, Rōšapi.
cells.remarks: Records a gift of land as dēvadāna, consisting of 3 pieces of Kakkōilgas, one a resident of Madurai, east of Madankulam, and the other of Tiruppavanam east of Irāśiṁgakulam. The taxes on the land amounting to 120 panam in all were to be paid by them to the temple in monthly instalments.

cells.location: Pīraṉmalai, Tirupputtūr taluk, Rāmnād district †
cells.place: On the south wall of the same shrine.
cells.remarks: Gift of land to the village Pēviņangalam by the assembly of Marungur-nādu as a maḍappuram to the meṭha in the premises of the Aḍiyamanāgiśvaramuḍaiya-Nāyanar temple at Mannukkuriṭṭi in the same nādu after exempting royal sanction.

cells.location: Pīraṉmalai, Tirupputtūr taluk, Rāmnād district †
cells.place: On the same wall
cells.date: 36th year, Vris-chika, dv. daśamī, Tuesday, Uttirai-tēdi.
cells.remarks: Records that the temple administration Mentions that the gift was made as a niṭṭaiyili for the maintenance of the maṭha which is stated to have been established during the stay at Mannukkuriṭṭi of Mudaliyār Ekamradēvar of the Dabahiçāgōla-maṭha of Tiruvarur, who was living in the Viradamudittiy-tirumaṇḍapam at Tirukoḍuṅkuṇram.

cells.location: Pīraṉmalai, Tirupputtūr taluk, Rāmnād district †
cells.place: On a slab set up in front of the Vēlippiliyār (Vināyaka) shrine in the same village.
cells.remarks: Records an order of the king's agents remitting the taxes due to the king on the villages belonging to the formari of Naḷlamaṇigapāgavasvāmi at Tiraimangai.

cells.location: Pīraṉmalai, Tirupputtūr taluk, Rāmnād district †
cells.place: On a rock near a spring called Śivafunai about a furlong west of the Misagunathēśvar temple.
cells.remarks: Records that this sacred spring together with the stone parapet is the gift of a certain Alagipurī alias Seliyanārāyanapuram, who also cut out the steps for reaching the pool and installed some figures on the parapet-walls.

cells.location: Pīraṉmalai, Tirupputtūr taluk, Rāmnād district †
cells.place: On a slab set up on the north side of the Tirupputtur-Kunakkuḍi road near the 4th mile from the former.
cells.date: Šaka 1587, Vlēvavasu, Tai 20, Friday, daṣam1, Anusha.
cells.remarks: Damaged and built in at the bottom. Records the gift of the village of Johobakalli, by a certain Kumāra-Vengala-Nāyakkar, for the maintenance of the service called Tiru-vanandu-kattalai in the temple of Tiruttaliśrattu-Nāyanar at Tirupputtur, a brahmādēya in Kēraḷasinga-vaḷanādu.

cells.location: Pīraṉmalai, Tirupputtūr taluk, Rāmnād district †
cells.place: On a boulder near a well called Bhimuduiguṇḍlu on the Tuluņu (hill) near Melleru, Yellavaram division, Godavari district.
cells.remarks: Records that Vamasamudram was constructed by Yuppala Hanumayya for the merit of Kaṭama-Redḍi Vēma-Redḍi.

cells.place: On the left side of the eastern entrance into the Kantumadhava-svāmin temple
cells.king: Jīvunji-Sababu Penmeśa Jagannatarāja †
cells.remarks: States that in the time of His Highness' Vijayarama-Gaja-patiyārāja-mahārāja terraces and other additions were made to the temple during the reign of the Jīvunji-Sababu Penmeśa Jagannatarāja.

cells.location: Padmanābham, Bimlipatam taluk, Vizagapatam district † — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: On a slab set up in a field known as Rājārjununi-tsunil at Pedda-pulipaka near Bezwada taluk, Kistna district.
cells.remarks: States that the pillar marks the boundary between the village Poḷupāka belonging to the get Mailēśvaran of Bejo-vāḍa and the village Yenumalankuduru.

cells.location: Padmanābham, Bimlipatam taluk, Vizagapatam district † — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: On a slab lying in a field to the north-west of the same village.
cells.remarks: States that the island (lunka) extending from this stone up to the Krishna on the south belonged to the village Yenu-malankuduru.

cells.location: Gudur, Bandar taluk, Kistna district — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: On two faces of a pillar lying in a mosque
cells.remarks: Much damaged. Records the re-grant of a village by Bālayarāja, son of Chalukya-Bhīma to the god Jaladhīs-vara of Ghaṇṭasāla.

cells.location: Gudur, Bandar taluk, Kistna district † — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: On another pillar lying in the same place.
cells.king: Rajadhirāja Kavati (Kavaṭi) Raghupatirāja †
cells.remarks: Damaged. Records the re-naming of the village Gmunduru as Raghupatipuram and granting it to some people, whose names are given, by Liṅgala Kēsamanēniṅgaru by order of Rajadhiraja Kavaṭi (Kavēṭi?) Raghupatiraja.

cells.location: Gudur, Bandar taluk, Kistna district † — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: On a slab set up in the same place
cells.remarks: A repetition of the text of the Shiite Durūd (of. Epigraphia Indo-Mostemica 1915-16, page 26). The writing is in the Thulth style.

cells.location: Gudur, Bandar taluk, Kistna district † — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: On the bank of the same slab place.
cells.remarks: Written in the Naskh style. Records the death of a certain Hashim of good habits and of angelic nature.

cells.location: Gudur, Bandar taluk, Kistna district † — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: On another slab set up in the same place.
cells.language: Persian (Verse) †
cells.remarks: Written in the Nasta liq script. Records the construction of the mosque by one Malik Nayab (Lord Deputy) of the king.

cells.location: On a beam in the Lakshmlnarasimhasvāmin temple at Avanigada, Divi taluk, Kistna district — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: Nandigama taluk, Kistna district.
cells.king: Krishnaraya †
cells.remarks: Damaged. Verses in praise of the god Lingodbhava. Mentions king Krishnaraya.

cells.location: Avanigadda, Divi taluk, Kistna district † — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: On a slab lying in a field to the south-east of Nandigama.
cells.remarks: Much damaged. Mentions Choda.

cells.location: Avanigadda, Divi taluk, Kistna district † — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: On a hero-stone set up near the same village.
cells.remarks: Records the death (?) of a hero called Jaka Bangaru-Reddi.

cells.location: Avanigadda, Divi taluk, Kistna district † — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: On a pillar in the mandapa of the Ramalingesvarasvamin temple in the same village.
cells.remarks: Records the construction and gift of the mandapa in the temple of the god Ramesvara of Nandigama, by Vasireddi Ramana-Dēśayi.

cells.place: On another face of the same pillar
cells.remarks: Records the construction and gift of the mandapa in the temple of the god Ramesvara of Nandigama, by Vasireddi Ramana-Dēśayi.

cells.location: Avanigadda, Divi taluk, Kistna district † — Andhra Pradesh

cells.remarks: Records the death of a hero called Pōtayya in a fight.

cells.place: On a slab lying close to the stream
cells.remarks: Records the gift of some lands made by some private individuals to the god Ramnatha-Mahadeva of Ravulapada.

cells.location: Yakkellapadu
cells.place: On a pillar lying near the Madiga quarters
cells.date: Śaka 1695, Pramādioba, Bhadrapada, śu. 7, Sunday. [date-calculation appendix, No. 255: Śaka 1595, Pramādicha, Bhādrapada, śu. 7, Sunday. Probably A.D. 1673, September 7, Sunday ; ·48.]
cells.remarks: Mentions Chagi Manmaraja. States that the pillar determining the boundaries of the villages of Nadigama, Ravulapada and Yakkellapadu was set up by the village headman, one of the Karanam, walked over the boundary and settled it.

cells.location: Muppalla
cells.place: On a pillar lying near the temple of Āñjanēyasvamin
cells.remarks: Much damaged. Seems to record a grant of land. Mentions Dōruya.

cells.location: Muppalla †
cells.place: On a slab lying under a tree to the north of the same village.
cells.remarks: Records the gift of 25 cows for a lamp to the god Rāmēśvara by Māika-Champa, who was the son of Kommapamba and Kommuna-Champa and the servant of the king. These cows were assigned to a certain Bairabōyini Bomman and his descendants, who were to maintain the lamp in the temple.

cells.location: Muppalla †
cells.place: On a broken slab lying in front of the Mallikarjunasvamin temple in the same village.
cells.remarks: Mutilated. Seems to record the gift of 55 'velledin' (sheep?) for a lamp to the god Bhīmēśvara by a servant of the Chagi family.

cells.location: Munagalapalli
cells.place: On a slab set up in the 'ruined' temple of Āñjanēyasvamin
cells.remarks: Records the grant of some lands to the god Bhīmēśvara-Mahadeva of Munagalapalli made by the king for the merit of his grandfather Peda-Chāgira, his maternal uncle (?) Pedaya, his father Bhīmarāja and his mother Parvatidēvi.

cells.location: Munagalapalli †
cells.place: On a slab lying near the tank-bund in the same village.
cells.remarks: Mutilated and damaged. Seems to record the construction of a pond and the grant of some lands by a certain Pinnayagāru. The village is called Munumalapalli.

cells.place: On a broken pillar lying near the image of Aňjanēyasvāmin

cells.location: Kāṇchala †
cells.place: On the same pillar
cells.remarks: Incomplete and mutilated. Seems to record a gift to the god Iśamēśvara-Mahādēva of Kēṇōbuharju by Malli-Nāyaka of the Yippara family for the merit of the king.

cells.location: Māgallu
cells.place: On a pillar set up in front of the Vēṇugōpālasvāmin temple
cells.king: Gaṇapatidēva †
cells.remarks: Dumaged and mutilated. Records the gift of some lands as well as 110 sheep for burning two lamps to (the god) Göpaladēva of [Mā]ṅgallu, by Nān isetṭi, Bhairisetṭi and Rārnisetṭi, sons of Bacchu Sūraya, for the merit of Kakatiya Ganapatidēva.

cells.location: Māgallu †

cells.remarks: Records that Baobuhu Sūrya granted some lands and a garden to the god Gōpāla of Mangallu. Refers to Aṇavõtu.

cells.location: Māgallu
cells.place: On the same pillar
cells.remarks: Damaged. Seems to record the dedication of his daughter (to the service of) the god Gōpāla by Mappi-Reddi and a gift of two cows and a plate for arati (waving lamp).

cells.location: Jonnalagaḍḍa
cells.place: On a slab set up near a well in front of the Śiva temple
cells.remarks: Do. Refers to a Vaiśya who belonged to Penukoṇḍa and to the Sūrakōla-gōtra.

cells.location: Koṇakaṇchi
cells.place: On a pillar set up in the Aňjanēyasvāmin temple
cells.remarks: Records a grant of 60 nivartanas of land by Pōta for offerings to the god Śrīkaṇṭha of Koṇḍakaṇchi.

cells.location: Koṇakaṇchi †
cells.place: On the same pillar
cells.remarks: States that Karreṇa-Seṭți and Kurvi-Seṭți, sons of Appisetti, minister of the temple of Narēndrēśvara, plundered the image of Narēndreśvara and Nāyaka-dēva and other gods of the temple at Narēndrēśvaram, Brahmādēva, plastered the shrines of the Panchayatana, and made grants of lands for offerings to the gods. It further states that Kurivi-Seṭți of the 'Teliki One Thousand' community of Bejavāḍa made a gift of two rows of lamps '(to the temple)'.

cells.location: Koṇakaṇchi
cells.place: On the same pillar
cells.remarks: Much damaged. Seems to register a gift of land for offerings to the god Narēndrēśvara of Koṇḍakaṇchi by some chief (name lost) who was the lord of Koḍūrpura and who belonged to the Kāśyapa-gōtra and the Solar race.

cells.location: Koṇakaṇchi †
cells.place: On a slab set up in front of the Durga opposite the Siva temple in the same village.
cells.remarks: Registers the installation of a lamp-pillar by Vatsa of Chempūru to the god Hanumanta of Konukañchi.

cells.location: Navahupeta
cells.place: On three pieces of a broken slab lying in front of the Siva temple
cells.remarks: Registers the gifts of lands in various places made by the king and Chagi Gaṇapatidēva to the god Svayambhudēva of Kurakūru.

cells.location: Navahupeta †
cells.place: On a broken pillar lying in the same place.
cells.remarks: Registers the gifts of lands in various places made by the king and Chāgi Ganapadeiva to the god Svayambhūdeva of Kurukūru. Also records a gift of lands by some private persons for burning a lamp (in the temple).

cells.location: Navahupeta †
cells.place: On a pillar set up to the south of the same temple.
cells.remarks: Registers a grant of land by the same chief to the god Sva-[ya]mbhunatha of Kurakūru. Also states that Lingama the anati of Sōmaya-Sāhini, granted some lands for rice offerings to the god, on 1 bursday, ba. 14 of Pushya in the (following) year Khara.

cells.location: Navahupeta †
cells.place: On the same pillar
cells.remarks: Registers a gift of lands to purchase to the god Mahādeva by Liṅgama.

cells.location: Peddaivaram
cells.place: On a slab set up in front of the Aṁjanēyasvāmin temple
cells.remarks: Damaged. Seems to record a grant of land and one perpetual lamp by certain individuals to the god Ravaṇantha of Ira[ra]ru.

cells.location: Peṇuganchi-prolu
cells.place: On a slab set up near a well in Oḍḍagudem
cells.remarks: States that well was built by Akkiṁji, son of Komarāju Kūḷamarāju, as a dedication to the god Narasiṁha.

cells.place: On a broken Naga-pillar in the house of the late Mr.K. V. Lakshmaṇana Rao in the same village.
cells.remarks: Damaged. Records the installation of the image of Yēlēśvara-Mahādeva by Dōra who was ruling over the Naṭavadi country and the grant (if some lands on the other bank of the river Munna for the daily offerings of the god.

cells.location: Anigaṇḍapādu
cells.place: On a pillar set up in the Kāsi-Visvēsvarasvāmin temple
cells.remarks: Registers a gift of lands made to the temple of Gōkisvara by Mahamaṇḍalēśvara Ivani-Kandradi Kēdarāchārya of the Durjaya-kula who was 'the lord of Bhōgapura.

cells.location: Anigaṇḍapādu †
cells.place: On the same pillar
cells.remarks: Registers a grant of land to the god Mallikarjuna of Mūlasthāra for daily offerings by the chief mentioned in No. 280 above.

cells.location: Anigaṇḍapādu
cells.place: On the same pillar
cells.remarks: Registers a grant of land made for offerings to the god Puṇḍarīka by Kēti-Nāyaka.

cells.location: Aṇumaṁchipalli
cells.place: On a pillar lying in the temple of Chādi Chaudanarāyanasvāmin
cells.remarks: Damaged. Gives the genealogy of the Chāgi family down to Manna-Gaṇapati. Records that Sōmayaji Bhāskara, son of Annamañchi-Kumārasvāmi-Yajvan and grandson of Chēvalēndra-of Srivatsu-gotra who had performed the Jyōtiśthōma and other sacrifices, installed an image of Siva at Chāgi-Manma-Gaṇapēśvara after the chief and that chief made a gift of lands for the daily offerings and worship of the god.

cells.location: Aṇumaṁchipalli †
cells.place: On another pillar lying in the same place.
cells.remarks: Records that the chief dug a canal resembling the river Kāvērī from the Kṣīranadī and a canal called Pōtavura and that Ammimañchi constructed a temple of Śiva and granted some lands for offerings in it.

cells.location: Jayantipuram
cells.place: On a dhvajastambha in front of the Āñjanēya temple
cells.remarks: States that a certain Appi-Reḍḍi set up the Garuḍa-stambha with the permission of his paternal uncle Peda Baoholi Pina Timmareḍḍi. Also states that a certain Veṅkanna, reinstalled the image of Āñjanēya.

cells.location: Jayantipuram †
cells.place: On a slab set up in front of the Ōṅkārēśvarasvāmin temple at Kavutavari Agraharam.
cells.remarks: Registers the grant of the village Narasiṃhanabagart on the bank of the Kaṣīranadī to Sūryanārāyaṇa-Yajvan of the Kauta family and the Kaśyapa-gōtra by Nṛsiṃha-Nṛpati of the Vāsiṣṭha-gōtra and the Vāsiṣṭha family. It also mentions the construction of the temple of Ōṅkāra-Naddēva and Gaṇapati in the village of Kavutavari by the members of the Kauta family and the grants made by them for the worship of the gods. Refers to 'king Rāma of this family.

cells.location: Kokkireni
cells.place: On a stone lying in front of the karṇam's house
cells.remarks: Much damaged. Seems to enumerate the taxes payable by the several communities. Mentions Kamya Boppanin-garu.

cells.location: Amaravaram
cells.place: On a slab set up in the Śiva temple
cells.date: Śaka 1753, Vikriti, Phalgupa, śu. 5, Tuesday; Fasli 1240.
cells.remarks: Registers the grant of lands made to the temple of Amara-śvarasvāmin at Amarāvatī by Mantripraḍa Sinayya and others who were the Zamindars of the Liṅgagīri Paragaṇa.

cells.place: On a slab set up in the back yard of the karṇam's house in the same village.
cells.remarks: Damaged. Mentions Rudramahādēvī, Mantri Keta and Rudraya.

cells.location: Nelamarri
cells.place: On the dhvajastambha in front of the Āñjanēya temple
cells.date: Śaka 1563, Vṛsha, Telugu Śrāvaṇa, śu. 2, Friday.
cells.remarks: Records the gift of the Garuḍa-pillar by Appaṇa-Gōvinda, son of Yellapa Mallaya.

cells.location: Taduvayi
cells.place: On a broken pillar lying near an image of Āñjanēya
cells.remarks: Nutilated and damaged. Seems to record a gift of land, a mango garden and a well for water-shed by Sūri-Seṭṭi to the god Chennamallinātha of Taduvayi.

cells.location: Taduvayi †
cells.place: On a pillar lying near a well in a field to the west of the same village.
cells.remarks: Damaged. Registers the grant of lands made to god Malli-kārjuna of Taduvāyi by Kati-Kēdđi for the merit of the king and of Kakatiya Ganapatidēva.
cells.also: <button type="button" class="xref-link" data-corpus="sii" data-key="sii|x||494" data-url="SII-Inscriptions.html">SII Vol. X, No. 494</button>

cells.place: On a slab set up on the bund of a tank called Maddalachervu in the same village.
cells.remarks: States that Peddi-Setṭi, son of Katikamu Malli-Setṭi, built two tanks at Taduvāyi one of which was for the merit of his mother Talama and named as Śingisamudram after her daughter Śingama.

cells.location: Taduvayi †
cells.place: On a slab set up on the bund of the tank called Yerracheruvu in the same village.
cells.remarks: States that the same person built another tank to the west of the village and named it Saṅgasamudram after his father Malli-Seṭṭi.

cells.location: Taduvayi †
cells.place: On a tomb to the east of Madhavaram.
cells.remarks: Records the death of Captain Henry Longford Burleigh of the 11th Regiment, N.

cells.location: Nadigudem
cells.place: On a slab lying in the Zamindar's residence
cells.remarks: Registers a grant of some lands and money by the people of Taḍuvāyi and of Nelamarri to the god Channa-Mallikārjuna of Taḍuvāyi for the merit of Mahāsāmanta Cheṟuku Jagaddāḷu Māraya Gaṇapaya-Reḍḍi. Also records a gift of a garden to the same god for lamps.

cells.place: On the same slab
cells.remarks: Registers a grant of land to the god Chenna-Mallikārjuna, while Mahāsāmanta Cheṟuku Jagadāḷu Annama-Reḍḍi 'was ruling the earth', by Allu Sūri-Seṭṭi.

cells.place: On a pillar lying in the same place
cells.remarks: Registers a grant of land by Mahāsāmanta Cheṟuku Jagadāḷu Annama-Reḍḍi and another with the consent of the people of Taḍuvāyi for offerings and worship of the god Mailāradēva of the village.

cells.location: Budavada
cells.place: On a slab set up near the Mutyalamma temple
cells.remarks: Records that an image of Gōpayya (i.e., Gōpāla) was installed and that some lands were granted to the god by Dachchibōyani Teluṅgarēḍu and his younger brother.

cells.location: Muktiyala
cells.place: On a slab set up in front of the central shrine in the Muktīśvarasvāmin temple
cells.remarks: Gives the genealogy of the Tyāgi family from Durjaya down to Tyāgi-Pōta (II), and records that the king granted the village Mukti for the daily offerings of the god Muktīśa-Mahēśvara, 30 cows and a crown made of precious stones.

cells.location: Muktiyala †
cells.place: On the same slab
cells.remarks: Damaged and incomplete. Records that the king constructed the temple of Muktīśvara, erected golden pinnacles over the shrines of Tripurāntaka, Kaśmīra-Mallēśvara, Viśvanātha and Chōḍa-Nārāyaṇa, built a tank called Chāgi-Pōtasamudram for the god Narasiṁha at Jiṁhari (i.e., Siṁhāchalam), installed the image of Nandikēśvara in front of the god Mallikārjuna at Śrīparvata and granted the villages of Kambhampāḍu, Muchchintalu and Būdapāḍu as dēvabhōgas and agrahāras to Brāhmaṇas in Nātavāḍi, etc.

cells.location: Muktiyala †
cells.place: On a pillar in the Kalyāṇa-maṇḍapa of the same temple.
cells.king: Kēśava †
cells.remarks: Records the gift of 25 cows for burning lamps to the god Muktīśa-Mahēśvara made by king Kēśava the lord of Īvani-Kaṇḍravāṭi.

cells.place: On the same pillar
cells.remarks: Gives the genealogy of the Īvani-Kaṇḍravāṭi family from Paṇḍa down to Kēśava (five generations).

cells.location: Muktiyala
cells.place: On the same pillar
cells.king: Kēśavadēva †
cells.remarks: Records the gift of 25 cows made by Īvani-Kaṇḍravāṭi Kēśavadēva for burning lamps to Muktīśvara-Mahādēva. The chief is said to belong to the Durjaya-kula.

cells.location: Muktiyala †
cells.place: On a slab set up to the south of the same maṇḍapa.
cells.remarks: Mutilated. Seems to record a gift of lamp made by a member of the Durjaya family.

cells.location: Vedadri
cells.place: On a slab set up to the south of the central shrine in the Lakshmī-Narasiṁhasvāmin temple
cells.remarks: Records that Sarakhumalu Jainadi-Vodeya, the younger brother of Mahāmaṇḍalēśvara Masanada Yeli Abibu Nidāmalu-Maluka (who bears several titles) who was ruling Vodapalli-Vajīrubāḍu on the banks of the Kṛishṇā in the Eastern Country was deputed to govern Śrīraṅgarājakoṇḍa, and that he constructed a tank at Jainadipuram and a flight of steps from the Kṛishṇā up the Śrīraṅgarājakoṇḍa for the merit of himself, his brother, Phērōju-Sultānu and Khoṇḍālamma (?).

cells.location: Vēdadri †
cells.place: On the same slab
cells.remarks: Praises Yijidi-Maluku and his charities, narrated in No. 306 above.

cells.location: Vēdadri †
cells.place: On a slab set up to the left of the western entrance into the same shrine.
cells.remarks: States that the image of the god Nrisimãa at Vedadri was reinstalled on this day by a certain Vennaya.

cells.location: Vēdadri †
cells.place: On a slab set up to the right of the same entrance.
cells.date: Śaka 118[1], Prabhava, Jyeshãha, bu. 16, Solar Eolipse.
cells.remarks: Mutilated at the top. Registers the grant of the village Vēmpuḷḷi for the offerings and worship of the god Pra-tāpa-Rudra-dēva, made during the reign of the king on the bank of the Kṛishṇaveṇī river.

cells.location: Vēdadri †
cells.place: On a slab set up to the west of the same shrine.
cells.date: Śaka 1648, Raktak-shi, Āśvija, šu. Lunar eolipse, Pushkaratirtha-punyakala.
cells.remarks: Registers the re-grant of some grazing lands made by Aṅkala Appaṇṇanṛu to the learned men of Vēdādri and their descendants. The grant was made in the bed of the Kṛishṇaveṇī river.

cells.location: Ravirāla
cells.place: On the wall to the left of the entrance into the Śiva temple
cells.remarks: Records the installation of a liṅga and construction of the prākāra, gōpura, etc., and records the laying out of gardens for the god Kūḍali-Saṅgamēśvara at the confluence of the rivers Kṛishṇa and Kēdranadī, by a Vaiśya named Toraṇāla Puḷḷayya-Veṅkayya belonging to the Pugaśila-gōtra.

cells.location: Ravirala †
cells.place: On the wall to the right of the same entrance.
cells.remarks: Records the consecration of the charities, detailed in No. 311 above, by Nāgaliṅgam of the Peṇḍikola-gōtra (perhaps in conjunction with the donor of that grant).

cells.location: Guḍimēṭla
cells.place: On a Nāga-pillar lying near a dilapidated mosque among the ruins of the fort
cells.remarks: Broken at the end. Gives an eulogistic account of the (Chāgi) dynasty. From the same place, records the grant of the lands that Pōta the father of the king installed god Vēvēśa at (his own capital) Guḍimēṭla on the bank of the river Kṛishṇaveṇī.

cells.location: Gudimeṭla †
cells.place: On the same pillar
cells.remarks: Broken at the end. Records the grant of lands in Eṭavōlu and Koṅguru made by Paṭṭa-Saṃhiṇi Dādi Gaṇṇama-Nāyaka for offerings to the god Viśvanātha-Mahādēva of Guḍimēṭla.

cells.location: Guḍimēṭla
cells.place: On the same pillar
cells.date: Śaka 1236, Ānanda, Māgha, ba. 14, Monday, Śivarātri
cells.remarks: Broken at the end. Records the grant of lands made by Kanna-mala Kaṇṇun-Nāyaku for daily offerings to the god Viśvēśvara-Mahādēva, for the merit of his parents. Given a list of the articles to be supplied every day for the offerings.

cells.place: On another pillar lying in the same place.
cells.remarks: Broken at the top. Records a grant of lands made by the King for offerings to the god Viśvēśvara and for the temple servants, for the merit of his father. Mentions the grant of a village.

cells.location: Gudimeṭla †
cells.place: On the same pillar
cells.remarks: Mutilated and damaged. Seems to record a grant made by Rudraya Tyāgi (i.e., Chāgi).

cells.location: Guḍimēṭla
cells.place: On the same pillar
cells.remarks: Damaged. Records grant of income from certain lands made by the king's commander Dādi Sōmaya-Sāhiṇi, son of Peḍḍaya-Sāhiṇi to the god Viśvanātha-Mahādēva

cells.location: Pokkanūru
cells.place: On a slab get up in the Ramaliṅgasvāmin temple
cells.remarks: Records the gift of 25 cows made by Mrucho- Dami-Reḍḍi for a perpetual lamp in the temple of Rāmanādeva of Pokkanūru, for the merit of his father Proli-Reḍḍi and of his mother [Ja]llāsāni.

cells.location: Pokkanūru †
cells.place: On the back of the same slab
cells.remarks: Records a gift of land made by Bōi-Seṭṭi for the offerings of the god Rāmeśvara-Mahādeva of Pokkanūru.

cells.location: Pokkanūru †
cells.place: On a rock lying near the temple of Muṭyalamus at Babbalapāḍu.
cells.remarks: Damaged. Records that a boundary dispute between the villagers of Guṇḍineṭi and of Babbalapāḍu was settled by Mēḍa Timmināyu performing the ordeal of walking over the boundary carrying a fire-pot. Mentions Gōrlaof Neṇḍigāma ṭhūṭa.

cells.location: Pokkanūru †
cells.place: On a slab set up in front of the Pōturāju temple in the same village.
cells.remarks: Registers the grant of a land at Babbalapāḍu in the Raṅgarāju-sīma made by Nama Yaramnēḍu to the deity Pōtarāju of the same village.

cells.location: Totaravalapāḍu
cells.place: On a slab set up in front of Muṭalalapalli Krishṇayya's house
cells.remarks: Registers the grant of the village Ravulapāḍu, which was now re-named Anachūpuram, made by Gajaravu Chenchali Annama-Nāyaka, to the god Mallikārjuna of Śrīparvata, for the merit of his mother Anachamma and of his family.

cells.location: Zruzzuru
cells.place: On a Naga-pillar set up in the Lakshmīnrishimhasvāmin temple
cells.remarks: Records the construction of temples, gōpuras and prākāras in the two temples of Lakshmī-Nrisimha at Yeguva (upper) and Diguva (lower) Tirumala, made by Rāja Kalavalūru Veṅkaṭanrisimharāya, son of Channarāya, and Rāmamāmbā and the grandson of Peddarāya of Svarnagiri-gōtra. Also registers the gift of a fixed share of all the grains (puṭṭi-kuñcha) grown in the villages of Vijayagirī-sīma, for the daily, fortnightly and monthly festivals and for the offerings of the god.

cells.location: Zruzzuru †
cells.place: On a broken Naga-pillar lying in the Śiva temple in the same village.
cells.remarks: Bottom of the pillar broken. Seems to register some gift made to the god Parameśvara, by some chief (name lost) bearing the title Vissānka Vīrapratāpa.

cells.place: On the same pillar
cells.remarks: Broken. Mentions the son-in-law (name lost) of Mahāmaṇḍaleśvara Chōḍa Pōtarāja who bears the biruda Nārasiṃhavardhana.

cells.location: Zruzzuru
cells.place: On the same pillar
cells.remarks: Seems to record gift of some land made by some members of the "Teliki One Thousand" community.

cells.location: Zruzzuru †
cells.place: On the dhvajastambha in front of the Āñjanēyasvāmin temple in the same village.
cells.date: Śaka 1638, Dunmikhi /Darmukha), Makha (mistake for Magha), śu. 12, Monday. [date-calculation appendix, No. 328: Śaka 1638, Dunmukhi, Makha, śu. 12, Monday. = A.D. 1717, January 18, Sunday ; ·40. The week-day cited in the inscription is evidently a mistake.]
cells.remarks: Damaged and incomplete. Mentions the god Hanāmanta and Rāuarāju Kommaya of Mēḍukūṇḍuru.

cells.location: Zruzzuru †
cells.place: On a slab sat up to the south of the same temple.
cells.date:
Śaka 1507, Parthiva, Vaisāka, śu.
paurṇami, Thursday.
cells.remarks: States that a well was constructed to the south-west of Julūru by Channayya, son of Pinsetti Mallaya and dedicated to (the god) Ranganātha.

cells.location: Vellanki
cells.place: On a slab built into the wall to the left of the entrance into the Śiva temple
cells.remarks: Records gift of lands and money by the people of Vellanki for the worship and offerings of the god Bhīmanāthadeva-Mahādeva of the village.

cells.location: Alluru
cells.place: On a marble pillar set up in the Śiva temple
cells.remarks: Fragment. Seems to register a perpetual endowment (akshaya-nīvi) of lands and money made by a certain Mahātalaivāra [for the benefit of the monk[s] (nigaya) of the Pūrvasailīyas.

cells.location: Alluru †
cells.place: On a slab lying in a field to the west of Timmapuram.
cells.date: Śaka 1744, Chitrabhanu, Adhika-Āśvija, śu. 5, Saturday, Sna. 1232 Faali, A. D. 1822, October 5.
cells.remarks: Records the settlement of the boundary between the villages of Bhairavunipeta and Jafarkhānpetta by the peons of the District Court of Machilīpatnam according to the decision of the Sadr Adalat Court of Channāpatnam (Madras).

cells.location: Konatamat-kuru
cells.place: On a pillar lying near the Añjaneya svāmin temple
cells.remarks: Records that Dānamudamya, the son of Pochārya and grandson of Dānamāmātya of the Lohita-gotra and the Karyabharaga (agent) of the king, constructed a beautiful temple with a maṇḍapa, installed in it the god Śiva under the name of Sūrośvara and granted some lands in the village Kirotachuruvu for the offerings of the god.

cells.location: Tripunitura, Cochin State
cells.place: In the west gopura (left of entrance) of the Santāna-Gopālakrishṇa-svāmin temple
cells.remarks: States that a minister called Vira Sri Ravivarma built the western gopura at Porratnāyatpala 'ripunittura) by the order of the king.

cells.location: Tripunitura, Cochin State †
cells.place: On the base of the east wall near the entrance into the same temple.
cells.remarks: Invocation to Vishṇu set up at Parnatrāyālaya.

cells.location: Tripunitura, Cochin State †
cells.place: On the same wall
cells.remarks: States that at the instance of Ramavraman a certain Nīlakaṇṭha built of black stones the temple at Pūrpatrāmangalam.

cells.location: Tripunitura, Cochin State
cells.place: On the same wall
cells.remarks: Verse in praise of the god at Purnatray1.

cells.location: Tripunitura, Cochin State
cells.place: On the same wall
cells.remarks: Refers to Purnataranpura (probably Tripunittura) and to some gods (dēva).

cells.location: Tripunitura, Cochin State †
cells.place: On a slab in the Jacobite Syrian church in the same village.
cells.language: Sanskrit in Malayalam. Prakrit in Va[s]eṭṭu †
cells.remarks: Mentions the death of Mattiri.

cells.location: Tripunitura, Cochin State †
cells.place: On another slab in the same place.
cells.remarks: Damaged.

cells.location: Tali, Tulappalli taluk, Cochin State
cells.place: On a slab in the Vadal-madam (left side) in the Śiva temple
cells.remarks: Records the settlement made by [Vay]chchan Pōndi of Pēyunapal-maṇṇam in Nedumpurayiṭr-naṇu with the (people and officers of) 18 districts of Nityarichārēśvara for providing food (to the Brahmaṇas) on the Aippigai and Chittirai festival days.

cells.location: Tali, Tulappalli taluk, Cochin State †
cells.place: On another slab in the same place..

cells.location: Melappaluvūr, Uḍaiyārpāḷayam taluk, Trichi-nopoly district †
cells.place: On a stone set up in a street in the same village.
cells.remarks: Seems to record the remission of taxes on the lands at Kīlparṇa a dēvadana of Avanikandarpiśvara of Melaippaļuvūr.

cells.location: Melūr, Trichinopoly taluk, Trichinopoly district — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On a slab lying in the Raghunātha Tātāchārya's tope
cells.remarks: Damaged. Seems to record a gift of land by purchase to the temple of Tiruviņṇagar by a certain Tiņmaiyaṅgār. Mentions the measuring rod called Iṟsāviyāday.

cells.place: On a slab lying in Seshādri Ayyaṇ-gār's tope in the same village.
cells.date: 36th year, Mithuna, śu., pañchami, Thursday, Param, Āni, 26.
cells.remarks: Damaged. Seems to record a gift of land by purchase to the temple of Tiruvarangaṇ by the queen Nachchiyār Ulagamuļudumudai-Ālvār, to provide garlands for the image of Ālagiya-Maṇvā|aperumā|.

cells.location: Melūr, Trichinopoly taluk, Trichinopoly district † — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On another slab lying in the same tope.
cells.remarks: Damaged and fragmentary. Mentions Avanivēudaramaṇ-sandi.

cells.location: Melūr, Trichinopoly taluk, Trichinopoly district † — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On a third slab in the same place...
cells.remarks: Ends of lines mutilated. Records a gift of land for the maintenance of a flower-garden, to Tirukkuṟuṅguḍi-Nambi.

cells.location: Melūr, Trichinopoly taluk, Trichinopoly district † — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On a slab lying in the house-site of Chiṉṇa-Naȳuḍu in the same village.
cells.date: 35th year, Mithuna, śu., pañchami, Thursday, Param, Āni, 26.
cells.remarks: Same as No. 405 above.

cells.location: Melūr, Trichinopoly taluk, Trichinopoly district † — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On a slab lying in Saṅkara-Koṇa's field in the same village.
cells.remarks: Damaged. Seems to record a gift of land, by purchase, for providing garlands for the god Śriraṅganatha.

cells.location: Melūr, Trichinopoly taluk, Trichinopoly district † — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On a slab lying to the north of the Sāvākar-tope in the Nāñyaka-kal paḍugai in the same village.
cells.remarks: States that this garden (tōppu) was the gift of Achohutappa-Nayaka (to the temple at Śriraṅgam).

cells.location: Melūr, Trichinopoly taluk, Trichinopoly district † — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On a slab lying in the field called Appavukkuōṇa- Karuppan-kuļiquai in the same village.
cells.remarks: Registers an allotment of ¼ vēli of land for the god Dhuvantari-Embērumān from the temple property.

cells.location: Melūr, Trichinopoly taluk, Trichinopoly district † — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On a slab lying in Mukhāyyikku-zangu tope in the village.
cells.remarks: Records an assignment of ¼ vēli of land for worship to each of the images of Paravāsudēva on the banks of the Chandrapushkarani, Poygai-Ālvār, Puḍattalvār and Pōy-Aļvār in the temple.

cells.location: Melūr, Trichinopoly taluk, Trichinopoly district † — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On a pillar in the field called Muṭṭukrishnan-Puļakkāṇpiōchchey in the same village.
cells.remarks: Fragment. Seems to record a gift of land as a tiruvidai-yāṭṭam to Tirukkuṛaļ-Appar and Nammalvar.

cells.location: Tanjore, Tanjore taluk, Tanjore district — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On the lintel of the southern entrance into the central shrine of the Bṛihadīśvara temple
cells.remarks: States that this is the entrance (built by or called after) Vikrama-Chōla.

cells.location: Tanjore, Tanjore taluk, Tanjore district † — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On a floor of the east prākāra of the same temple.
cells.date: Śaka 1723 (expir-ed), Kali 4902, Durmati, Vaiśakha 3, 6u. dvitiya, Thursday, Rōhinī.
cells.remarks: Records that the king executed the repairs to the temple.

cells.location: Tanjore, Tanjore taluk, Tanjore district † — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On a floor of the east prākāra of the same temple.
cells.date: Śaka 1723 (expir-ed), Kali 4902, Durmati, Vaiśakha 3, 6u. dvitiya, Thursday, Rōhinī.
cells.remarks: Records the repairs executed by Sarfoji-Mahāraja to the 26 sections of the north verandah of the prakāra.

cells.location: Tanjore, Tanjore taluk, Tanjore district † — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On another pillar in the east end of the same prakāra.
cells.date: Śaka 1723 (expir-ed), Kali 4902, Durmati, Vaiśakha 3, 6u. dvitiya, Thursday, Rōhinī.
cells.remarks: Do. [The one above is engraved at the beginning of the first section of the repaired prakāra-wall.]

cells.location: Tanjore, Tanjore taluk, Tanjore district † — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On the floor of the same prākāra
cells.remarks: Incomplete. Begins with the genealogy of the Bhonele family of the Mahraṭhas which is fully given in the record on the south wall of the verandah (No. 424 below).

cells.place: On the floor of the well near the Sabbapati-maṇḍapa in the same temple.
cells.date: Śaka 1724 (expir-ed), Kali 4903, Rudhirōdgari, Srāvaṇa, Ādi, 10, 6u. pañchamī, Saturday, Uttarā.
cells.remarks: Records that the tank in the north prakāra called Maṇduka-tirtha was rebuilt in the form of a well.

cells.location: Tanjore, Tanjore taluk, Tanjore district † — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On one of the steps of the Ganapati shrine in the same temple.
cells.date: Śaka 1723 (expir-ed), Kali 4902, Durmati, Vaiśakha 3, 6u. dvitiya, Thursday, Rōhinī.
cells.remarks: Records that the king renewed the Ganēśa temple and constructed the ardha-maṇḍapa and the mahā-maṇḍapa.

cells.location: Tanjore, Tanjore taluk, Tanjore district † — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On the north and west case of the same shrine.
cells.remarks: Records the settlement of a dispute regarding the hereditary right of enjoyment of Veṭhiyaṅ-kaņi at Tañjā-nagara between certain individuals, by the ordeal of dipping the fingers in boiled ghee.

cells.location: Tanjore, Tanjore taluk, Tanjore district † — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On the west and south walls of the same shrine.
cells.remarks: Records the gift of jewelled ornaments and silver vessels to the temple by the king.

cells.location: Tanjore, Tanjore taluk, Tanjore district † — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On the north wall of the maṇḍapa in front of the same shrine.
cells.date: Śaka 1723 (expir-ed), Kali 4902, Durmati, Vaiśakha 3, 6u. dvitiyā, Thursday, Rōhinī.
cells.remarks: Enumerates the various items of repairs executed in the temple by the king.

cells.location: Tanjore, Tanjore taluk, Tanjore district † — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On the south wall of the veranda of the same temple.
cells.date: Śaka 1725, Rudhirōdgari, Marga-āirsha, ba. amavasya, Tuesday, A.D. 1803, December 13.
cells.remarks: Gives in detail and in chronological order the line of the Mahārāja kings of the Bhōsle family from the early times, recording also the military exploits of each.

cells.location: Tanjore — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On a pillar in the mosque called Sōmeupupalli near the railway station
cells.remarks: Records a gift of seven vēli of land to the Faqirs of Sūmupuppall by five Muņquayyars of Nañjinkōṭṭai at the instance of the king.

cells.location: Tiruvaiyaru, Tanjore taluk, Tanjore district † — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On the base of the Pushya-man-dapa
cells.remarks: Elogises the King and states that he made several gifts to the temple of Ranganatha at Srirangam, that he reconstructed the dam across the Kaveri which had been breached, and that he made the Hiranyagarbha gift.

cells.location: Pallavarayanpettai, Maya-varam taluk, Tanjore district — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On the north wall of the mandapa in front of the central shrine in the Sundaresvara temple
cells.date: Year lost. Tula, ba. saptami, Wed-nesday, Puradam.
cells.remarks: Records a gift of sheep for burning a lamp in the temple of Rajarājēsvaram-Udaiyar which had been constructed at Kulāttūr in Tiruvindalūr-naḍu, a subdivision of Rajadhiraja-valaṇaḍu, by a certain Kulāttulān Tiruchchirtambala-udaiyan Perumal-Nambiyar alias Pallavarajar, a native of Karigai-Kulāttūr in Siṭokanpra-naḍu, a subdivision of Āmur-koṭtam in Jayaṅgondasōla-mandalam.

cells.location: Pallavarayanpettai, Maya-varam taluk, Tanjore district † — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On the same wall
cells.date: 16th year, Tula, ba. saptami, Wed-nesday, Puradam.
cells.remarks: Records an agreement by a certain shepherd to burn three perpetual lamps in the temple, two of which seem to have been endowed in the 14th year of the king in Kumbha, ba. 3, Wednesday, Uttiram.

cells.location: Pallavarayanpettai, Maya-varam taluk, Tanjore district — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On the same wall
cells.remarks: Records a gift of 48 sheep by another shepherd to burn half a lamp in the temple.

cells.location: Pallavarayanpettai, Maya-varam taluk, Tanjore district — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On the same wall
cells.remarks: Stones out of order and portions lost. Records a sale of land to the temple by thee individuals.

cells.location: Pallavarayanpettai, Maya-varam taluk, Tanjore district — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On the same wall
cells.remarks: Records an agreement by a shepherd to supply ghee for a lamp in the temple in return for sheep received by him.

cells.location: Pallavarayanpettai, Maya-varam taluk, Tanjore district † — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On the west and south walls of the central shrine in the same temple.
cells.remarks: Records the non-payment of taxes, due from the 28rd to the 26th year of the king, by a certain person and the subsequent attachment of his property from his wife and son by bringing up his lands for sale, and the gift of the same for worship, offerings and a lamp in the temple for the welfare of Pil]ai Sola-Kōnar.

cells.location: Pallavarayanpettai, Maya-varam taluk, Tanjore district † — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On the south wall of the mandapa in front of the same shrine.
cells.remarks: Begins with the introduction உலகளந்த பெருமாள், etc. Mentions the circumstances of the king's grant through the exertions of the king's tiruchchirrambala-mudaiyan Perumanambiyar alias Pallavarayar, after the death of king Rajaraja (II). Registers the royal grant of 40 veli of tax-free land at Solendrasimha-nallur in Kurukkai-nadu, a subdivision of Virudarajabhayankara-valanadu, in some specified proportion to the temple of Pallavarayar on his demise. Refers to the campaign of Lankapura-Dandnatha and the refuge offered to Kula-sekhara by the king against the Ceylonese general.

cells.location: Pallavarayanpettai, Maya-varam taluk, Tanjore district † — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On the same wall
cells.date: 10th year, Sithha, śu. tryōdaśi, Friday, Tiruvoṇam. [date-calculation appendix, No. 434: Saka 1388, Vyaya, Magha, śu. daśami, Thursday, Rohini, Brahma-yōga, Garaja-karana, Kumbha-lagna = A.D. 1467, January 15, Thursday ; ‘50; ‘81.]
cells.remarks: Records a sale of land to the temple of Rajaraja-isvaram-Udaiyar at Kulattur in Tiruvindalur-nadu, a subdivision of Rajadhiraja-valanadu, by two private individuals of Tiruvindalur.

cells.location: Pallavarayanpettai, Maya-varam taluk, Tanjore district † — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On the same wall
cells.remarks: Begins with the introduction பூவமருவிய திருமகள், etc. Records the gift of some lands, as tax-free, for offerings and worship and for a flower-garden to the temple of Rājārajīsvaram-Udaiyār at Kulattūr by the-lady mentioned in No. 427 above by whom the temple had also been built.

cells.location: Pallavarayanpettai, Maya-varam taluk, Tanjore district — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On the same wall
cells.date: 18th year, Siñha, tritiyā, Thursday, Āltam (Hasta), 18th year, Mina, tritiyā, Sunday.
cells.remarks: Records a sale of land to the temple by Kāśyapan Arasa Srīkrishna-Bhattan one of the two individuals mentioned in No. 434 above.

cells.location: Pallavarayanpettai, Maya-varam taluk, Tanjore district † — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: At the entrance into the gopura of the same temple.
cells.remarks: Registers a sale of land belonging to the temple of Kīrtinārāyaṇa-Vinnagar-Ālvār near the village to the Rājarājayapuram-Udaiyār temple.

cells.location: Maṇamadura, Sivaganga taluk, Ramnad district — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On the north wall of the central shrine in the Somanāthasvāmin temple
cells.remarks: Much damaged. Seems to register some endowment by two individuals to the temple at Manavīramadura-chaturvedimaṅgalam.

cells.location: Maṇamadura, Sivaganga taluk, Ramnad district † — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On the same wall
cells.remarks: Damaged. Registers a gift of land to the temple of Somanāda-Nayinār at Vānaviramaduraī.

cells.location: Maṇamadura, Sivaganga taluk, Ramnad district † — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On the north, west and south walls of the same shrine.
cells.remarks: Damaged. Registers a sale of land belonging to a temple of Tiruchohuiramudaiya-Nayanar to a temple.

cells.location: Maṇamadura, Sivaganga taluk, Ramnad district † — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On the south wall of the same shrine.
cells.remarks: States that Ara[ni]dī Rādudavan composed a verse in praise of the god Sōmīsara and His consort. Much damaged.

cells.location: Maṇamadura, Sivaganga taluk, Ramnad district † — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On the same wall
cells.remarks: Portions lost and stones misplaced. Seems to register a gift of tax-free land to the temple.

cells.location: Maṇamadura, Sivaganga taluk, Ramnad district † — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On the north and south base of the same shrine.
cells.remarks: Registers a gift of money and paddy by a resident of Tiruvālivāy for worship and offerings to this image of Al[tara]li-Naya nār in the temple every Sunday.

cells.location: Maṇamadura, Sivaganga taluk, Ramnad district † — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On the pillar of the mukha-maṇḍapa in the same temple.
cells.remarks: Damaged. Registers a sale of land, to the assembly of Manamadura-chaturvedimaṅgalam, a brahmadeya in Tiyanadarkuṛi-nādu, by a committee of the mahāsabhā of Rājagambhīra-chaturvedimaṅgalam in Rājagambhīravalanādu. Mentions another date 730.

cells.location: Maṇamadura, Sivaganga taluk, Ramnad district † — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On the base of the verandah in front of the same maṇḍapa.
cells.date: Śaka 1263, Sīha, śu. paurṇima, Monday, Śrāva-yaun.
cells.remarks: Registers an assignment of some temple lands to a certain pāṇḍāram for hereditary service in the temple.

cells.location: Maṇamadura, Sivaganga taluk, Ramnad district † — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On the south wall of the prākāra in the same temple.
cells.date: Śaka 1819, Bahu-dhānya, Uttirāyana, Vasanth-ṛitu, Chittirai 17, śu. paurṇima, Thursday, Chitra.

cells.location: Maṇamadura, Sivaganga taluk, Ramnad district † — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On the north wall of the central shrine in the Vīralur temple in the same village.
cells.date: Śaka 1438, Dhatu, Uttarayana, Rishabba, 6u. trayōdaśi, Wednesday, Variha-yōgam, Vyaghra-karapa, Svāti. [date-calculation appendix, No. 447: Śaka 1437, Dhātu, Uttarayana, Rishaba, śu. trayōdaśi, Wednesday, Variha-yōgam, Vyāghra-karana, Svati. = A.D. 1516, May 14, Wednesday ; ·13; ·22.]
cells.remarks: Seems to record a gift of land called Alāharsravalli by purohane, by a certain lady of Patṭinādi [ka]ranallūr in Pagaliyar-nādu to the temple of Alager-Alvar at Kōvīran-mandalam and built a temple on the northern bank of the river. Mentions Bhuvanēka vīra-pāṇam and Rāyarvasil Timmaṇapa-Nāyaka, the administrator of Madura and Sundarattōlaudaiyar alias Mavali-Vāṇadarāyar who 'revived the past'.

cells.location: Maṇamadura, Sivaganga taluk, Ramnad district † — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On the east wall of the maṇḍapa in front of the same shrine.
cells.date: Śaka 14[38], Bhava, Rishabba, 6u. trayōdaśi, Wednesday, Variha-yōgam, Vyaghra-karapa, Svāti. [date-calculation appendix, No. 448: Śaka 14[38], Dhātu, Rishabha, śu. trayōdaśi, Wednesday, Variha-yōgam, Vyāghra-karana, Svati = A.D. 1516, May 14, Wednesday.]
cells.remarks: Seems to record a gift of lands in different villages as sarvamānya for worship in the temple of Paramasvāmī.

cells.location: Maṇamadura, Sivaganga taluk, Ramnad district † — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On the north base of the same maṇḍapa.
cells.date: Śaka 1486, Rakta-kshi, Dakshinā-yana, Varsha-rita, Kanni, ba. Monday, Makha, Pīta-yōga, Sithira-karanas, amāvāsyai.
cells.remarks: Records an assignment of some temple lands to a Veṇjāla as a permanent possession, certain specified taxes being payable by him to the temple annually.

cells.location: Maṇamadura, Sivaganga taluk, Ramnad district † — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On the south base of the same maṇḍapa.
cells.remarks: Fragment. Seems to record a gift of money for burning a twilight lamp in the temple of Śrīvallabhēśvaram-uḍaiya-Nayinār.

cells.location: Maṇamadura, Sivaganga taluk, Ramnad district † — Tamil Nadu
cells.place: On the north, west and south bases of the Saundaryavalli-Amman shrine in the same temple.
cells.date: Śaka 146[8], Man matha, Dakshi-nayana, Varsha-pitu, Tula 1, 6u. pañohami, Friday, Jyōshṭha, Saubhagya-yōga, Sirīha-karapa, Arpaśi, Vishu. [date-calculation appendix, No. 451: Śaka 1467, Krōdhi, Śravana, ba. 7, [Wednesday] = A.D. 1545, July 29, Wednesday, f.d.t. ·23. cells.remarks: Registers the ratification, by Sundaratōludaiyar Mavalī-Vāṇadarāyar, of the gifts of lands in various places to the temple of Aļagar at Vānavirāmanudurai, made by his aunt Alankaravalli.

cells.location: Tiruchohānur, Chandragiri taluk, Chittoor district — Andhra Pradesh
cells.place: On a stone built into the pavement of the main gopura of the Padmavakī Amman temple
cells.remarks: Fragment. Seems to record the gift of paddy received as puravu from Tiruchohānugamur and the money realised by fine (to the temple).
